name: restore a bona fide executable curl binary
definition: Ensure the CLI binary at the standard path is a real native executable (not a stub or script) with the executable bit set and reports its expected identity.
failure_mode: A replaced or chmod-zeroed binary fails the integrity checks.

name: restore a package manager into a python interpreter from its bootstrap script
definition: Download the official pip bootstrap and run it to reinstall the pip module into the environment rather than relying on a broken system copy.
failure_mode: Bootstrap not fetched or run, leaving pip absent.
